capabilities: Run a countdown timer with start, interrupt, and abandon controls in a side panel
Log each finished tomato to a date-sectioned Markdown file with quality ratings
Suggest recent task names when starting a session
Show Day, Week, Month, and Task statistics with charts and a year contribution grid
Send desktop notifications when a tomato completes or is abandoned
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer; makes no network requests and collects no telemetry; can also be installed manually from releases or via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in focus timer, and standalone Pomodoro apps store session history outside the vault instead of in plain Markdown.

relations.evidence: Install and enable the BRAT plugin.

summary: Pomodoro-style focus timer that runs in a side panel and logs sessions, interruptions, and statistics to a Markdown file in the vault.
